name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wide while raising your arms overhead.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A classic full-body cardio exercise performed in place.
